note: The Differentiation record, machine-readable (kogaki#1206, owner decision
2026-09-26). It replaces two things at once: the free-text hint each
reader-path unit's prompt used to carry ('choose a reader experience
unlikely to be the one they choose'), and the collision refusal that used
to be read only AFTER all three units had already composed a full
Candidate. This record is decided BEFORE any unit composes: one entry per
unit, assigning the reader-state dimension its path leads with, the
opening Move its first Leg binds, and (where the Brief carries Journey
material) where that material is placed. The three Candidates differ BY
ASSIGNMENT, not by chance.
IT ALSO AUTHORS READER START, ONCE PER BRIEF, AND LISTS THE MOVES THE
FIRST LEG MAY BIND (kogaki#1216, owner decision 2026-09-28). Reader start
is a cold read -- the stance a reader with the declared Persona holds
toward this Thesis before reading the article -- authored from the reader
file the workflow table names (rendered in this ask's input as `reader`)
and the adopted Thesis, never from any Move. `leg1_survivors` is every
Move whose `before` does not contradict that Reader start on a dimension
it declares, unranked; each unit's `opening_move` is drawn from it. Both
are decided HERE because both are properties of the Brief and of no
path: three units authoring Reader start would author one fact three
ways, and the exclusion could be checked against none of them.
THIS RECORD IS THE BLOCK'S CURRENT OUTPUT, AND NOT ITS DEFINITION
(SPEC-draft-pipeline §"Journey register is an axis of Candidate
differentiation"). A later mechanism deciding differentiation a
different way keeps the same state name and the same boundary — before
the reader-path units start — and may reshape this record's fields
without that section itself moving.
SPEC REFERENCES IN THIS FILE (kogaki#902; one carrier, kogaki#982).
The rule these entries are written under lives in ONE place:
`src/SPEC-REFERENCES.md`. It is not restated here.
THE NAMES THIS FILE USES, and the spec each one names:
Journey register is an axis of Candidate differentiation
SPEC-draft-pipeline

reader_start.shape: one `dimension: value` LINE per dimension, over the Move library's five (knowledge, question, expectation, orientation, trust)
authored_from: the reader file the Brief workflow table's `compose_path` row names (readers/dev-to-zenn.md), rendered in this ask's input as `reader`
the adopted Thesis, in the Brief document
reader_start.never_from: any Move's `before` -- Reader start is a COLD READ: the stance a reader with the declared Persona holds toward this Thesis before reading the article (kogaki#1216, owner decision 2026-09-28). Deriving it from the Move the first Leg will bind is what produced a Reader start that read like a reader who had already read the article several times

lines.knowledge: what this reader holds about the Thesis's subject, bounded by the Persona's `prior_knowledge`; a term the Persona lists as unknown may not appear
lines.question: `holds: none`, or a question in the reader's OWN words that follows from why they opened the post -- never a question in the article's terms
lines.expectation: what this reader expects of this genre, from `reader` plus the Thesis
lines.orientation: how they currently frame the subject, from `reader` plus the Thesis
lines.trust: the default a peer's post gets from this reader, from `reader` plus the Thesis

reader_start.derivation_is_judgment: each line is derived from a named Persona field plus the Thesis; the derivation is composition judgment stated to the composer and linted nowhere (Every MUST is judgment). The Persona is never copied into the Brief
reader_start.rationale: ONE per Brief, authored here rather than per unit: Reader start depends on the Persona and the Thesis and on no path, so three units authoring it would author one fact three ways, and the first-Leg exclusion below could be checked against none of them

leg1_survivors.rule: EXCLUSION, NOT OPTIMIZATION (kogaki#1216 amendment, owner decision 2026-09-28). A Move is EXCLUDED when its `before` CONTRADICTS `reader_start` on a dimension it declares; a Move that omits a dimension is not excluded on it. Every Move not excluded is a survivor, and survivors are NOT RANKED -- no score exists anywhere. List every survivor by id
leg1_survivors.count_is_rendered: the Brief records how many Moves survived, beside Reader start. A count of one names the LIBRARY, not the rule, as the cause of a repeated opening, and the fix is a Move analysed from an opening passage
leg1_survivors.rationale: the first Leg binds a survivor by the same composition order every Leg uses -- Strand information, then Leg reasoning, then the Move -- and the grounds test applies to it; the check is the existing specialization verdict applied to Leg 1 against `reader_start` (`specializes` passes, `contradicts` refuses). An empty list is refused: a library with no Move able to open from this Reader start is a store fault to name, never a Brief to compose

entries.count_rationale: one entry per reader-path unit — a record with fewer entries leaves a unit with no assignment, and one with more names a unit that does not exist

unit_number.rationale: the join key the reader-path unit's own prompt and the assembled Candidate's tag both resolve through — never the unit's opening Move or dimension, because those are exactly the values being assigned

dimension.rationale: the Move library's five reader-state dimensions (src/leg-schema.json, reader_state_before/reader_state_after); two units leading with the same dimension are not differentiated by assignment, they are differentiated by luck

opening_move.rationale: the id the unit's first Leg must bind — checked at composition by the unit's own retries and re-checked at assembly against the Candidate that resulted (src/assemble.mjs), naming the unit on a mismatch

journey_placement.absent_when: the Brief carries no Journey material at all (journeyBearingStrands over the Brief's Strand set returns no Strand)
journey_placement.rationale: where this unit's path places the Journey register, decided in advance rather than left to whichever unit's Model happens to reach for it (SPEC-draft-pipeline §"Journey register is an axis of Candidate differentiation")

reader_experience.rationale: one sentence of intended reader experience — carried into the unit's own prompt so the unit composes toward it, not a description read back after the fact

refusal.rationale: a record with two entries sharing a leading dimension, or an opening Move outside moves_you_may_bind, is refused at the state with the entry named — never silently repaired and never deferred to the units that would compose against it
